Workflow.Name: PPLF | Forwarder | Dataverse to SharePoint
Workflow.Description: When Log Target is SharePoint, entries that pro-code sources (plug-ins, model-driven JavaScript, Custom API) write straight to the PPLF Log table are copied to the SharePoint list and removed from Dataverse.
